review_notes: I read the whole file and searched the repository for the same reasoning elsewhere. The only repeated nontrivial machinery I found is the "integral matrix and integral inverse give a unit determinant" argument. It appears in v_det_le_one and v_det_eq_one_of_mem_localLevelOne here, and in two other solution files with almost identical proofs. I also saw iotaGL_unipotent, unipotentGL2_eq_unipotent and v_det_le_one_of_integral copied across many files. Those proofs are short (fin_cases plus simp, or a 2x2 determinant estimate). I did not report them, because the rubric excludes short calculations and thin wrappers. In the main theorem, the hUdet, hUset and hmemU blocks each occur once, so I found no internal repetition. The proposed shared lemma is untested, and I did not check whether its placement is compatible with how the solution files are meant to be self-contained. Its proof sketch comes from the two existing proofs, which compile.

findings.problem: The same argument is reproved in at least three solution files. The steps are: entries ≤ 1 give v(det) ≤ 1 via det_fin_two and the ultrametric inequality; the same holds for k⁻¹; then v(det k) * v(det k⁻¹) = 1 forces v(det k) = 1 by a le_antisymm/mul_le_mul_right squeeze. In this file the squeeze is the final calc block of v_det_eq_one_of_mem_localLevelOne. S_..._unitShell.lean has near-verbatim copies, v_det_le_one and v_det_eq_one_of_mem_K2, differing only in the hypothesis (k ∈ K₂). S_..._ideleNorm_det_eq_one_of_shellSupport_rat.lean has a third copy, valued_det_eq_one_of_mem_localLevelOne_top, which re-proves the ≤ 1 bound inline. Each copy restates the long Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup coercions by hand, and a fix in one will not reach the others.
findings.proposed_change: Add one generic lemma where the existing local-level-one API lives (Definitions or Theorems, since the solution files already import those). Suggested name and statement: `v_det_eq_one_of_integral_of_integral_inv {F} [Field F] [Valued F (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))] (k : GL (Fin 2) F) (h : ∀ i j, Valued.v ((k : Matrix _ _ F) i j) ≤ 1) (h' : ∀ i j, Valued.v (((k⁻¹ : GL (Fin 2) F) : Matrix _ _ F) i j) ≤ 1) : Valued.v ((Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det k : Fˣ) : F) = 1`. Proof: v_det_le_one for k and k⁻¹, then the hprod/le_antisymm squeeze above. Alternatively, apply `Valuation.map_mul` to `det k * det k⁻¹ = 1`, then use `mul_le_one'` and the group-with-zero order. The two uses then become one-liners. In this file: `rw [AdelicDock.mem_localLevelOne_iff] at hk; exact v_det_eq_one_of_integral_of_integral_inv k (fun i j => (HeightOneSpectrum.mem_adicCompletionIntegers _ _ p).mp (hk.1.integral i j)) (fun i j => (HeightOneSpectrum.mem_adicCompletionIntegers _ _ p).mp (hk.2.integral i j))`. In the K₂ file, the same call is made with `hk.1`/`hk.2`, which that file already states in the `≤ 1` form. The `_top` copy would call it the same way as this file.
findings.benefit: The determinant-unit argument is written once instead of three or more times, and each use shrinks from about 25 lines to a few. The long coercion-heavy calc is removed from the solution files, and the one remaining statement can be read and maintained in one place.
